roleContext.roleTitle: Service Operations Manager, Financial Reporting System
roleContext.jobDescription: The financial reporting system of an insurance group produces the monthly close packs and regulatory returns. The Service Operations Manager runs the live service: owns the production support rota, has run production month-end closes and their incident handling, coordinates production changes with finance and IT, and is accountable for the live service's availability during the close window. Hands-on experience running the system in production, not only in test cycles, is required.

requirements.text: Has run the financial reporting system in production through month-end closes, including production incident handling.
Owns the production support rota and the close-window escalation procedure.
Coordinates production changes with finance and IT during the change window and records own responsibility boundaries.
Maintains the close runbook and the service dashboard for the reporting system.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions after each close cycle.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Service Operations Manager, Financial Reporting System

## Experience

- Ran the month-end close rehearsals for the new reporting system in the pre-production environment for five cycles, executing the close runbook end to end against a masked copy of the ledger and logging every deviation for the programme team.
- Maintained the close runbook and the service dashboard prototype for the reporting system, updating both after each rehearsal cycle with the timings and the open defects.
- Coordinated pre-production changes with finance and IT in the programme change window; the live service was still operated by the incumbent supplier, whose service manager handled production incidents during the parallel period.
- Drafted the production support rota and the close-window escalation procedure that the programme planned to adopt at cut-over, reviewed by the head of finance systems.
- Responsibilities included close rehearsals, runbook and dashboard maintenance, change coordination and rota drafting for the reporting system replacement programme over about fourteen months.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the close runbook with the rehearsal timing log for five cycles and the draft support rota, with the pre-production environment's job identifiers as a verification trail.
